purpose: Three final-selected-model functional illustrations. Not an optimization acceptance gate, calibration corpus, representative accuracy benchmark or paired 512px performance workload.
selection: Three ordinary-object photographs outside all 32 calibration image IDs; COCO license 4 plus freshly verified Flickr oEmbed CC BY 2.0, complete author/title/page. Captions were used to select subject matter; rubrics were written from direct inspection of the exact images before any model run.

review_policy.method: Human semantic review of the three listed observations per image; accept ordinary synonyms and record omissions or false visual claims. No candidate selection or optimization acceptance decision is based on this smoke set.
review_policy.limitations: Only three single images, no temporal/action-sequence evaluation. Native source dimensions vary; any backend resizing and sample timing must be reported separately from the frozen 512px paired benchmark.
